nodes.objective:
Create src/ahra/alignment_session.py implementing a real Agent-driven
AlignmentSessionManager per docs/architecture/intent-alignment-workflow.md
and ADR-0009. It must:
1. Accept an IntentDraft and drive multi-turn dialogue via the AgentDriver
   port (src/ahra/ports.py) - do not import any model/cloud SDK directly.
2. Keep immutable per-turn session state snapshots with turn history.
3. Resolve profile/digest references from GoalOperationProfileRegistry and
   reject unknown references with a structured error (never fabricate a digest).
4. Emit an untrusted RequestDraft on convergence, never a frozen
   GoalExecutionRequest.
5. Be resumable from any state snapshot.
Also create tests/test_alignment_session.py with deterministic fake-AgentDriver
fixtures asserting: agent-driven dialogue is actually invoked; unknown digest is
rejected; resume-from-snapshot works; output is an untrusted RequestDraft.
Run uv run python -B scripts/check.py --test and record it in
WorkReport.verification_commands_run.
Verify the alignment session implementation and its tests are present and consistent.

spec.rationale:
Dogfood: use Workflow B (development-bounded profile, real Agent) to build
a real Agent-driven alignment session manager for Workflow A, per ADR-0009,
replacing the deterministic template stub. Writes are confined to the
A-workflow path allowlist; the B kernel is on the write blacklist.
